expectations: Explains why immediately revoking `IAMAllowedPrincipals` (`Super`) on a brownfield database without auditing active principals breaks existing IAM-backed Glue/Athena workloads, and shows how **Lake Formation Hybrid Access Mode** enables incremental opt-in before final cutover (`references/lf-tbac-and-data-filters.md`).
